limits: Common class retains initial-zero notification suppression; standard ACM is not qualified.

The new positive includes serial bulk-OUT traffic before notification qualification. Earlier type-only experiments waited for notification without that traffic; this comparison does not establish that dual mapping alone changed the earlier outcome or that notification progresses independently of bulk traffic.
Target queued TX receipts alone do not establish host delivery; full serial pass requires all per-end bytes/hashes/modem/notification checks.
FIFO bit15 is asynchronous/periodic classification; no RAM selector, frame counter or precise update mechanism is inferred.
Fixed-port bounded RAM experiments, native120s lease and authenticated physical recovery; no persistent or post-loader software reset.
